subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Introduced to the rectangle and how it differs from other shapes

show.line: This is a rectangle. Two long sides and two short sides. Like your bath towel!

rounds.prompt: What shape is this? Say it with me. Rectangle!
Which one has two long sides and two short sides?
Count the corners on the towel.
Put the rectangles in one group and the squares in the other.

hints: A rectangle is long. Two sides are longer.
A square has sides all the same. A rectangle does not.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will name the shape of this towel.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Look, the towel is a square!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Two sides are long. It is a rectangle.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look together. Long side, short side. It is a rectangle!

parent_line: Can recognise a rectangle and tell it apart from a square.
